finding: Yosys honors user src/hdlname attributes. A one-sync-stage clone named fake_fifo with copied approved metadata was previously counted as one approved FIFO and returned PASS_SOURCE_GRAPH_ONLY.
fix: Unfingerprinted input RTL with reserved src/hdlname attributes or Yosys $paramod identities is refused before elaboration.
Only actual FIFO base/canonical derived module types can become audited FIFO cuts; hdlname metadata alone is insufficient.
Unapproved clone without forged metadata is traversed as ordinary source and its crossings REFUSE.
scope: Soft-parent admission only; independent retest and production physical gates remain required
